units.source_text: 突然，我有点说不出口了。

en.t: Suddenly, I found myself a little unable to speak.

units.source_text: 话说了一半，猛然发现哥哥英吉不知何时站在我身后了。

en.t: Halfway through speaking, I suddenly realized that my older brother Eikichi had somehow come to stand behind me.

units.source_text: 哥哥露出瞧不起我的表情，冷漠的说：“你这不懂事的小妮子！

en.t: My brother wore a look of contempt for me and said coldly, "You foolish little girl!
What difference do the hina dolls make?

units.source_text: 你忘了刚才爸爸怎么骂你的吗？”

en.t: Have you forgotten how Father scolded you just now?"
